sections.heading: 1. Four steps up
lines: ① From lying, roll onto your side.
② Push up onto hands and knees.
③ One foot forward: half kneel, hand on chair.
④ Push up. Lead with each leg, 3–5 times a day.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Can you get down on the floor and back up again without a second thought?

It sounds simple, but it's a skill that combines strength, balance and confidence. Summer picnics, playing with the grandkids and floor stretches all rely on it, and practising it can make a slip less worrying.

Start in steps next to a chair: roll to your side, push onto hands and knees, come into a half kneel, then push up. Lead with each leg, 3 to 5 times a day. Sit-to-stands from a chair build the strength behind it.

A recent fall or dizziness on standing is worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can tailor it to you. Book online via the link in bio.
